newsitem.title: TURKEY: Akbank, Sabanci sell Turk Philips stake.
newsitem.headline: Akbank, Sabanci sell Turk Philips stake.

text.p: Turkey's Akbank and Sabanci Holding said on Monday they had sold their stakes in Turk Philips units to Philips Electronics NV.

In a statement to the Istanbul stock exchange, Akbank, owned by Sabanci group, said it had sold its stake in Turk Philips Ticaret for $1.49 million, its shares in Turk Philips Sanayi for $1.29 million.
It also sold its stake in Turk Philips Aydinlatma to Philips Lighting Holding B.V. for $2.8 million.
In a similar statement, Sabanci Holding said it sold its shares in Turk Philips Ticaret for $1.17 million, its stake in Turk Philips Sanayi for $1.046 million.
Sabanci Holding also sold its stake in Turk Philips Aydinlatma to Philips Lighting for $2.2 million.
Both companies did not disclose percentage sizes for the stakes.
